method: Same viewport and content-frame geometry; current UI sources are byte-identical to the final UI candidate; the last build changes only the offline encoded container. All build identities and source proof are retained.  reference and runtime are combined visually. Sample fixture values/art identity and required actual game states are listed separately. Captures keep their original candidate source stamp; final targeted corrections are independently verified.
